text:
Lena: Quick ask - Prospect Altair wants a 1-week Private/VPC POC next Thurs. Requirements: SAML assertions must never go over public internet, prefer IPv6 for client traffic, and procurement wants a short non-tech note PrivateLink vs Peering. Can NetOps + Sec weigh in?

Omar: Short take: PrivateLink narrows firewall scope and avoids cross-account routing. Peering is cheaper (no connector surcharge) but gives broader L3 reachability and more route table work. If SAML absolutely cannot leave their network, recommend Private deployment or a tiny SAML-proxy in their VPC that uses PrivateLink to our control plane.

Priya: IPv6 callout: our hosted PrivateLink connector is IPv4-only today. Customer can enable IPv6 client traffic via NAT64/DNS64 or an IPv6->IPv4 gateway for connector subnets. Native v6 on the connector is not GA; flag as blocker if they insist on native v6 for the connector. Control-plane (SAML) can be proxied over IPv4 PrivateLink.

Omar: Minimal firewall allowlist (example placeholder CIDRs):
```
# outbound from customer app/subnets -> Redwood endpoints
TCP 443 -> 34.201.200.0/22   # control-plane callbacks / auth
TCP 443 -> 52.209.16.0/22    # model-serving (hosted)
# Optional: ICMP echo to 34.201.200.0/22 for health checks
# If they require static egress IP for IdP ACLs: allow TCP 443 from our EIP pool (we will share exact IPs)
```

Priya: TLS inspection note: if the perimeter does TLS MITM, customer must either allow SNI passthrough for our hostnames or install our cert chain on the inspection device; otherwise SAML POSTbacks will fail. Also require TLS1.2+ and modern ciphers.

Lena: Pricing question: is there an extra connector fee or per-GB egress for PrivateLink?

Omar: Yes — hosted PrivateLink has a monthly connector surcharge + per-GB egress. Private deployment = separate license (platform fee + support). I'll paste the exact pricing line after the call.

Priya: POC preflight checklist we can hand to their NetOps: 1) Provide VPC (/20 recommended) or pick existing VPC with two spare private subnets. 2) Reserve two private subnets for connector components (no public IPs). 3) Pre-authorize outbound HTTPS to our control-plane CIDRs (we'll provide exact ranges). 4) If IPv6 needed for client traffic: deploy NAT64/DNS64 or an IPv6->IPv4 translation gateway and validate with our test endpoints. 5) If SAML must remain private-only: deploy a lightweight SAML bridge VM in their VPC that proxies assertions to our control plane over PrivateLink. 6) Optional: request static egress EIPs for IdP allowlists 12 we will provide list.

Lena: Procurement also checked "no shared IPs". Is PrivateLink sufficient?

sec-bot: PrivateLink gives endpoint-level isolation and avoids cross-account routing, but it does not guarantee single-tenant physical hosts. If they require dedicated hardware/host tenancy, open an Ops ticket for dedicated-hosting evaluation. Mark as gating if procurement needs it. :lock:

Lena: Can NetOps + Sec join a 30-min sync at 10:30am PT today to finalize the one-pager and firewall snippet? I want to send the pre-provision checklist to the buyer after the call.

Omar: 10:30 works for me, will bring CIDRs and a sample route-table diff.

Priya: In. I'll bring NAT64 notes and TLS/cipher guidance.

Lena: Thanks all 1F44D I'll schedule and share the checklist after the call.
